props.title: Why this approach
items: Prioritize overdue invoices by value and aging bucket.
Route ghosting vs. late-payment scenarios with explicit rules.

props.title: Validation target
props.target: At least 5 qualified leads from first 20 targeted users in 14 days

props.title: Guardrails
items: Fewer than 2 qualified intent captures after 20 targeted visitors
Core workflow completion rate below 20% in first-session usage

props.title: Start with one pilot workflow

items.question: Will this replace our accounting tool?
items.answer: No. It focuses on follow-up execution workflow and can run alongside your accounting stack.

items.question: Can we customize escalation tone?
items.answer: Yes. Rules can be tuned by account tier, delay age, and customer relationship sensitivity.
